messages.author: 3119a620bed30885
messages.subject: 'Make' is not recognized
parts:
I just installed Stan and Rtools.  I have not used Stan before.  I am following the instruction for building Stan on page 7 of "Stan Modeling Language".  I get the error message "make" is not recognized as an internal or external command, operable program or batch file.

Rtools is installed on c:\ and make.exe is in c:\Rtools\bin

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] 'Make' is not recognized
parts:
You need to add c:\Rtools\bin to your PATH and then
open a new command window.

- Bob

On Tuesday, February 25, 2014 3:37:20 PM UTC-5, Bob Carpenter wrote:
You need to add c:\Rtools\bin to your PATH and then
open a new command window.

We need to emphasize this in the installation instructions for Windows. Rtools has an option at the end to edit the path, but it is unchecked by default and requires administrative privledges to actually do it.

Ben
